underlying_release: simdjson 5.1.1 (single-header amalgamation vendored in the pysimdjson sdist; DOM parser with runtime-dispatched arm64 NEON kernel on linux/arm64)
build_note: Source-built from the pinned sdist with Cython 3.3.1 and clang/clang++ -O0 plus LLVM source coverage. The official aarch64 cp311 manylinux wheel compiles the same sources (arm64 and fallback kernels) into one optimised csimdjson extension; generated Cython C++ and optimisation may differ.
api: simdjson.Parser().parse(local JSON bytes, recursive=True); Parser().load(local path, recursive=True) is checked against the same oracle
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: LLVM source-region coverage of the source-built csimdjson extension: Cython-generated csimdjson.cpp and util.cpp wrapper counted separately from vendored simdjson.cpp/simdjson.h
scope: JSON structure and values from local bytes via simdjson.Parser().parse(data, recursive=True); valid nested object and nested array controls only, each matching an exact type-tagged CPython json oracle tree
